edge_cases.top_k_ties: sort by lower token id after descending logit

metrics.stability_predicate: top1_agrees AND top_k_jaccard >= min_topk_jaccard AND probability_jsd <= max_probability_jsd AND rank_movement <= max_rank_movement

oracle.selection_rule: minimum cost_units, then maximum boundary; expose every boundary in the frontier
